name: KinPath
summary:
Plan your journey in this micro RPG autobattler, leading generations of brave frogs through growth, uncovering treasures, confronting mysterious foes, and building a lasting family legacy.

Chart a course for your frog’s adventure and shape their destiny. As they travel through diverse locations, your little hero will grow stronger, gain new skills, and uncover treasures.

Will they delve into magic, embrace the swiftness of a rogue, or stand firm as a resilient fighter? The journey is yours to plan!

Every adventure has new enemies to face. Watch your frog tackle these challenges with the skills and items they’ve gathered along the way. Their success depends on the choices you made when planning their path.

Guide your frogs through different locations and uncover the map piece by piece. Embark on quests to develop your skills, collect resources and shape your character's story.
